meaning.en: A woman's wide-brimmed bonnet with a flap at the back to protect the neck from the sun.

sentences.en: The invention relates to an inflatable sunbonnet. The sunbonnet mainly comprises three parts including a brim inner container, a material of an upper layer and a lower layer of the brim and a crown.
